description: A transposer for V/Oct signals: triggers step the transposition up or down by a set interval, wrapped to stay inside one octave

params.text: Sets the interval each trigger transposes by, -12 to +12 semitones; 7 walks the circle of fifths

inputs.text: A rising edge lowers the transposition by the SHIFT interval, wrapped back inside the octave
A rising edge raises the transposition by the SHIFT interval, wrapped back inside the octave
A V/Oct signal to be transposed, polyphonic
A rising edge returns the transposition to zero

outputs.text: The signal from its own input with the current transposition added

notes: the display shows the current transposition in semitones
